headlines.text: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit. Unverified video shows a drone hitting the Northern Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country. State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution. Pike's lawyers said the failure "goes far beyond any one person". Pike is in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections.

Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations. Michael Kotlikoff described the allegations of a woman who says she was drugged and gang raped as "deeply disturbing".

'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis. More than 50 protests took place on Saturday after the government failed to get emergency legislation through parliament.
What to know about Brazil's election pitting Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro. Polls suggest the election will be a closely run contest between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing rival.
Debris found from plane that went missing off US coast. The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.
US father and son arrested after 'gas station heroin' deaths. They are accused of selling at least one student derivatives of kratom, often called "gas station heroin" in the US.
UK-Iranian dual national bailed after RAF Fairford incident arrest. The 25-year-old man was arrested in the London borough of Westminster on Thursday.
Kim wins Asian Games gold to secure military exemption. Golfer Tom Kim wins gold at the Asian Games to secure an exemption from mandatory service in South Korea's military.
Why Canada is preparing for a (long shot) US invasion. Prime Minister Mark Carney has said the military is running scenarios in the unlikely case the US invades Canada.
Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer. Ghana is a predominantly Christian country where preaching on public transport is widespread.
Could El Niño mean there are no Atlantic hurricanes this year?. For the first time in three decades there has not been a single Atlantic hurricane in September, normally the most active month.
Photos: Community unites in Senegal’s Dakar to clean dilapidated school. Volunteers and students prepare safer, cleaner classrooms in advance of the academic year in Senegal's capital.
Bosnia votes in one of world’s most complicated general elections. Voters cast their ballots for a dizzying number of officials across multiple tiers of government.

Sabalenka, Rybakina handed shock defeats at China Open tennis. The Belarusian’s exit follows top seed Rybakina losing to unseeded Charaeva in her first match as world number one.
Gaza’s Christians mourn mother and daughter killed in Israeli attack. Maysa Abu Daoud and her daughter Mary al-Najjar among five Palestinians killed in Gaza City attack.
Saudi-led coalition dismisses ‘misleading’ Houthi claim of Riyadh attack. The Saudi-led coalition spokesman says the Yemeni armed group is 'attempting to divert attention' from its losses.
Fury to invite US President Trump to lead ring walk before Joshua fight. Tyson Fury is keen for his 'old pal' to join his procession to the ring for the fight on December 11 in Cardiff.
Yamal scores stunning goal in Spain’s 3-1 Nations League win over Czechia. Lamine Yamal is the first player to score within the first 10 minutes of each of three consecutive men's football games.
West Indies beat India in record chase as Hope hits 162 in third ODI. Shai Hope's 162 leads the West Indies to a record cricket run chase as they beat India by five wickets in the third ODI.
Widespread damage after huge hailstones pound Paraguay capital. Large hailstones pounded parts of Paraguay’s capital, breaking windows and denting cars.
Somalia President: Houthis ‘not in a position’ to bring Yemen peace. Somalia’s president accuses the Houthis of destabilising the region and disrupting navigation through the Bab al-Mandeb
Bosnia general election 2026 explained in maps and charts. Bosnians head to the polls on October 4. Here’s a quick guide to the voting process, candidates and what's at stake.
Trump defiant about midterm chances as he rallies for Republicans in Ohio. US president tells a rally in Ohio that he believes there will be a 'big surprise' in the upcoming elections.
Saudi-backed Yemeni army says 700 Houthis killed in 24 hours. Yemen’s government forces claim to have killed hundreds of Houthi rebels as they attempt to retake lost territory.
Milt Windler, NASA flight director who helped save Apollo 13, dies at 94. "...we were making history."
The dawn of the age of the exoskeleton. The devices continue to show noticeable benefits for users in various real-world tasks.
This startup pays NYC residents to run air conditioners on free batteries. Bonus: Every Electric’s batteries are beloved by household cats.
Keurig Alta First-Look: No More Plastic K-Cups. Keurig is ready to ditch the K-Cup with a compostable and plastic- and aluminum-free coffee pod, but the price is steep.

Elusive ‘Geoneutrinos’ Are Building a New Map of Earth’s Volatile Interior. A global network of detectors are reporting some of the most substantial measurements yet of neutrinos created deep underground by the radioactive elements that power our planet’s tectonic activity.
The Nvidia Shield TV Is 7 Years Old. It Just Got a $100 Price Hike. The price of anything with memory is skyrocketing thanks to AI. Aging streaming devices are no exception.
Muse Creates Detailed Profiles of All Your Friends and Family. Millions have downloaded Meta’s AI agent Muse. But getting it to do your bidding comes with privacy costs.
How to Collect CDs. Fed up with paying to stream music you’ll never actually own? Give the little silver disc a spin. Here’s how to start a CD collection or get more out of one you already have.
The Best E-Readers That Aren't a Kindle (2026): Kobo, Boox. Want to untether your reading from Amazon? These Kindle alternatives deserve a spot on your nightstand.

Best Mosquito Repellents for Your Yard: What Works and What Doesn’t (2026). After years of testing repellents, traps, and sprays, I found a few ways to keep the bugs at bay—and plenty that aren’t worth the effort.

How an Uzbek truck driver’s fatal crash exposed troubling fraud trend in Middle America: ‘Chameleon carriers’. Uzbek-linked trucking companies in southwest Ohio face scrutiny over CDL fraud, English proficiency violations and fatal semi-truck crashes on U.S. roads.

California K-9 Otis helps police seize 440 pounds of cocaine during Alhambra traffic stop. K-9 Otis sniffed out roughly 440 pounds of cocaine during a California traffic stop after the driver's shifting stories raised red flags to responding officers.

Brewers take Game 1 of NLDS after a controversial call on sure-fire home run ball that hit the stadium roof. William Contreras launched a go-ahead solo homer in the seventh inning as the Milwaukee Brewers edged the San Diego Padres 3-2 in NLDS Game 1.

Shooting near Baltimore youth football event leaves 12-year-old girl dead, 3 adults wounded. A parking dispute near a youth football event at Leon Day Park in Baltimore turned deadly when two men allegedly opened fire on each other, killing a 12-year-old girl in the crossfire.

Texas mother facing capital murder charges after allegedly shooting her two sons to death. Colleen Nichole Lemmon allegedly told officers she shot both her sons at their Waxahachie home before deputies found her with self-inflicted injuries.

Yankees lose ALDS Game 1 to Rays as Austin Wells is thrown out at third after breaking up no-hitter. Austin Wells broke up Drew Rasmussen's no-hit bid with a double but was thrown out trying to stretch it to a triple in the Yankees' painful loss.

Trump touts ‘golden age’ at Ohio rally, urges voters to deliver GOP midterm wins. President Donald Trump urged Ohio rally-goers to "pretend I'm on the ballot" as he stumped for Jon Husted and Vivek Ramaswamy in the midterms.

France’s violent student protests raise warning for America: ‘A cautionary tale’. "The Big Weekend Show" co-host says the country's violent student protests are "a cautionary tale" for the U.S., warning open borders lead to unrest and misplaced anger.

South Carolina football in free fall as Shane Beamer may be out of time with buyout decision looming. South Carolina football decision makers face mounting pressure after its eighth straight SEC loss, with Shane Beamer's $22.5 million buyout looming large.

Phil Collins gets frank on marriage failures and life regrets: 'I regret my marriages falling apart'. Phil Collins told Piers Morgan his Genesis touring schedule destroyed his first marriage and revealed deep regrets about all three marriages falling apart.

Minnesota quarterback gets kicked in the crotch by teammate en route to upset win over Michigan. Minnesota's Bennett Warren accidentally kicked QB Drake Lindsey in the groin during a celebration in the Gophers' upset win over Michigan football.

Cornell president says university 'must do better' on handling of sexual assault allegations. Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff said the university "must do better" after questions arose over its handling of fraternity sexual assault claims.

Pete Hegseth handles Air Force-Navy coin toss after showing off basketball skills at Academy. Pete Hegseth uncorked a Caitlin Clark-like series of three-pointers at the Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs before the football game kickoff.

Florida Gators run into buzzsaw in Missouri, Tigers shred top-ten team for rare ranked win at home. Austin Simmons threw for 340 yards and two scores as the Missouri Tigers demolished the No. 8 Florida Gators 45-17, holding Jadan Baugh to 13 yards.

'Caddyshack' star Michael O'Keefe claims cocaine was budgeted on set, admits filming scenes high. Michael O'Keefe opens up about rampant cocaine use on the "Caddyshack" set, saying people treated the drug "like it was toothpaste" in the '70s.

Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona. Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.
Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people. Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing.

Can the Cornell lawsuit force changes that make students safer?. Universities have responsibilities when students report sexual assault, even if prosecutors don't bring charges. Attorney Baine Kerr explains how those protections work.
Opinion: A Hawk is not the same as a Hawkeye. This was emphasized to people watching a Senate hearing this week, where confusion over two basketball teams was on display.

Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports. The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

All's fair in love and 'War' — a well-cast, classy-trashy divorce drama. HBO's War is intended to be an anthology series about two dueling London law firms. The first season stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a high-profile couple in the midst of a very nasty divorce.

Just short of its 200th birthday, a landmark natural history museum shuts down. Beloved for its dinosaurs, Philadelphia's storied Academy of Natural Sciences closed down this week, amid an intense fight by local residents, politicians and scientists to save it.

No one expected Leo to be pope — except everyone who knew him as 'Bob'. When the 2025 conclave began, no one expected an American pope. But by its end, Cardinal Robert Prevost had become Pope Leo. Here's a look behind the scenes.

4 ways to battle performance anxiety, according to a confidence coach. Worried about stumbling before a high-stakes event, like a race or a job interview? Psychologist Cindra Kamphoff offers creative strategies to overcome the jitters and build confidence in the moment.
